## Problem 1

### (i)

By Definition,

$$
\begin{align*}
E[Y|X=x] &= \sum_y y \times p(y|X=x) \\
&= \sum_y y \times \frac {P(X=x, Y=y)} {P(X=x)}
\end{align*}
$$

So,
$$
\begin{align*}
E[Y|X=1] &= 2 * \frac{\frac{1} {36}} {\frac{1} {36}} = 2 \\
\end{align*}
$$
